summary: Protected PR #1009 adds this terminal-cut source witness; it does not establish a complete population or native acceptance. At the existing ordinal-six Python readback hold, a transparent test observer forwards the identical read memory and cancellation token once to the real Python stdout stream, without synthetic bytes, buffer copying or read-ahead. Its wrapper task awaits the actual stream task and clears the pending-call observation in finally. Both tasks and their registered continuations must remain incomplete during inspection. Named-field joins show the production callback state belongs to the execution assembly, retains the exact session callback bridge and awaits the observer task; the bridge channel uses that observer, whose target is the real stdout stream. The observer state awaits the exact underlying task. The bridge reader task is incomplete and present in the session retained-task set. Generated state names, field paths and at most eight ancestor lookups are assertions; changed or unavailable structure fails without a scanning fallback. The production buffer is the exact supplied memory backing: one byte of complete array capacity, memory length one and offset zero. Identity checks distinguish it from the eleven selected terminal backings and twenty-six request/capture arrays in coordination/managed-held-cut-backing-roots. Inspection output retains scalar capacity, memory length, offset and join results. Settlement requires the pending observation to be cleared; failure releases holds, retires Python and joins existing cleanup. Python resampling, six exact slots, three ACKs, terminal confirmation and settled-task assertions remain required. This adds one terminal-cut root relation, separate from the earlier ACK/child-read cut in coordination/managed-held-ack-child-read-roots. It does not establish physical reclamation, a complete simultaneous population or a combined peak/fit budget. Other runtime/stream/encoding, caller/backend/peer and uncertainty populations remain unresolved. Closed-profile admission remains refused; installed custody, native ACK authentication and original-operation replay/effects remain held.
title: Terminal callback read joins its one-byte backing through actual pending stream tasks
